scripts.build:local: tsc -b && vite build --mode dev --base / --outDir dist-local && node scripts/promote-pages.mjs dist-local
scripts.build:beta: npm run verify:beta && tsc -b && vite build --mode beta --outDir dist-beta && node scripts/promote-pages.mjs dist-beta
scripts.build:final: npm run verify:final && tsc -b && vite build --mode final --outDir dist-final && node scripts/promote-pages.mjs dist-final
scripts.build:release: npm run verify:release && tsc -b && vite build --mode release && node scripts/promote-pages.mjs
scripts.build:offline: npm run verify:release && tsc -b && vite build --mode release --base / --outDir dist-offline && node scripts/promote-pages.mjs dist-offline && node scripts/package-offline.mjs
